units.source_text: 起初约定每次相隔四天，第五天续弈。

en.t: At first, it was agreed that each session would be separated by four days, and play would resume on the fifth day.

units.source_text: 在箱根就是这样进行的。

en.t: That was how it was carried out at Hakone.

units.source_text: 间歇四天，本是为了让棋手休息。

en.t: The four-day intervals were originally meant to let the players rest.

units.source_text: 可禁闭在旅馆里，老名人反而更增添了疲乏。

en.t: But being confined in the inn only made the old Master even more exhausted.

units.source_text: 他的病越发严重了，也曾提出过缩短四天的休息时间。

en.t: His illness grew worse, and he even proposed shortening the four-day rest period.
But Otake, seventh dan, flatly refused.

units.source_text: 箱根最后一日，提前了一天，即在第四天就续弈了。

en.t: On the final day at Hakone, the schedule was moved up by one day, so play resumed on the fourth day.
That day, the Master made only one move.

units.source_text: 虽遵守了规定的对弈日，可最终还是违背了从上午十时至下午四时对局的规定。

en.t: Although the scheduled day of play was observed, in the end the rule requiring play from ten in the morning until four in the afternoon was still violated.
